text:
Maya: Quick design check — updating the SLO alert threshold row copy + the screen-reader announcements for the channel preview. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/SLO-alerts (see 'preview' frame). Please skim for copy clarity + a11y nits. Oliver: Quick skim: love the compactness. Two copy nits: 'Suppression preview' reads ambiguous — maybe just 'Preview (simulated)'? Also the small button currently labeled 'Notify channel' should be 'Send test notification' for clarity. Sarah: PM note — we need to make it crystal clear this is a simulation and does not persist routing/changes. Suggest a subtle hint under the preview header: 'This sim will not change live notification routes.' design-bot: Mock flows: focus order -> threshold row -> preview toggle -> send test button -> channel pill list. Modal closes should return focus to threshold toggle. a11y-bot: ARIA note: when the preview fires, use aria-live=\"polite\" to announce: \"Test notification sent to X channels (simulated)\". Do not use assertive unless it's a real incident. Also ensure channel pills have aria-pressed states and keyboard focus styles. Oliver: Keyboard behavior: when I tab through the preview modal on Chrome mac, channel pills get focus AFTER the 'Close preview' button, which is confusing. We should ensure linear tab order mirrors visual order. Also the escape key should close preview and restore focus to the threshold toggle. Maya: Good catches. For copy, proposing: header -> 'Preview (simulated — does not modify routing)'; button -> 'Send test notification'; small helper -> 'Last simulated: —' (timestamp). For threshold copy replace vague phrasing like 'Incident if > 5% errors' with 'Trigger when error rate > 5% for 5 minutes' so users know window semantics. Sarah: Add a tiny help icon on the threshold row that opens a short tooltip: 'How we evaluate this threshold (rolling window, aggregation)'. Helps avoid support pings. Oliver: Suggested code snippet for live region (for engineers): ```
Test notification sent to 3 channels (simulated)
``` Make sure the string is concise and localized. design-bot: Microcopy guideline: use sentence case for labels, avoid parentheses in button labels, and prefer 'Simulate' vs 'Preview' in places where the action is explicit. Maya: Agreed on sentence case. I'll update fig with: header 'Preview (simulated — won't modify routes)', primary action 'Send test notification', helper 'Last simulated: 2026-03-22 14:12 UTC'. Will also adjust tab order and add tooltip copy. Maya: @a11y-bot can you run a quick keyboard nav + screen reader smoke test on mac+voiceover and windows+nvda once I push? Post findings here. a11y-bot: On it — will report back with any focus/announce diffs. Oliver: Small UX polish: when the user sends a test and a channel fails (eg. webhook 500), surface a non-modal inline toast in the preview area with the failed channel name and a tiny 'retry' link. No global toast — keep context local. Maya: Good idea. I'll mock the inline toast state too. Thanks all — will push updated fig + small PR for aria-live string and tab order this afternoon.
